description: Hello, I am Hady from STEM Behera school.
summary: so basically our project indicate that humans have left earth before long time ago they are living in a far habitable planet called kepler452-b so the station choose 4 astronauts to be selected to the mission of returning to earth, while in the space they faced some problems like a sudden disorder in the space craft, they also passed two new habitable planets (trappist-1e, kepler442-b) so they collected some materials and return to the main journey at the end the finally reached for their destination
details: our project is for any age its educational game to make people know about the space in general and if there is actually a habitable planets besides earth we used html to program the game the hardware windows and the software visual studios
